name: saas-demo-api
description: API demo - login, session, endpoint tenant-scoped di atas RLS, field terenkripsi

scripts.dev: prisma generate --no-hints && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/src/main.js
scripts.test:e2e: prisma generate --no-hints && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.seed:demo: prisma generate --no-hints && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/scripts/seed-demo.js
scripts.bootstrap:superadmin: prisma generate --no-hints && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/scripts/bootstrap-superadmin.js
